reason: Permit event-linked maturity only when there is a real long-stop date.

proposed_change.old_text: - A term linked to a specific, identifiable event, such as the closing of a Series B funding round, with a 'long-stop' date of at least 24 months.
proposed_change.new_text: A term linked to a Series B financing or similar liquidity event may be accepted only with a long-stop date of at least 24 months and no lender discretion to accelerate absent default.
